name: planner
description: Sidebar view of the Atlas work dashboard, the same page as the Claude artifact, with a read-only Today and Tomorrow fallback from the Obsidian dashboard.

view/title.when: view == planner.atlas || view == planner.today || view == planner.tomorrow
view == planner.atlas || view == planner.today || view == planner.tomorrow
view == planner.atlas || view == planner.today || view == planner.tomorrow

planner.atlasPage.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the Atlas page, the HTML the Claude artifact is published from. Leave empty to use `_Dashboard Sync/dashboard-page.html` in the vault. When the page cannot be read, the sidebar shows the Today and Tomorrow panes instead.

planner.atlasServer.markdownDescription: Name of the local dashboard server under `mcpServers` in the Claude desktop config. The Atlas page calls it as `host:dashboard`; VS Code starts the same command.

planner.clients.markdownDescription: Only show tasks under these client headings, e.g. `["Acme"]`. Set this per repository in `.vscode/settings.json`. Leave empty to derive the client from the `clients` path map in `~/.claude/obsidian.json`; if that also finds nothing, every client is shown.

planner.dashboardPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to `Dashboard.md`. Leave empty to read `vault` + `dashboard` from `~/.claude/obsidian.json`.

planner.pollSeconds.markdownDescription: How often to re-read the dashboard as a fallback, in seconds. The file watcher is the primary trigger; polling covers vaults on iCloud or another sync client, whose writes do not always raise a watcher event. `0` disables polling.

planner.showClientHeadings.markdownDescription: Show the client name above its tasks. `auto` shows it only when more than one client is visible.

planner.showCompleted.markdownDescription: Show `- [x]` tasks. Toggled by the eye button on the view title bar.

planner.vaultRoot.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the Obsidian vault. Task links such as `[Details](Clients/…)` are relative to the vault, so this is what they resolve against; clicking one opens it in markdown preview. Leave empty to use `vault` from `~/.claude/obsidian.json`. Without either, those links show as plain text.

scripts.package: bun run build && bunx --bun @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --out planner.vsix
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
